name: Algebraic Incidence Framing
description: Transforms a graph connectivity problem into an equivalent linear algebra problem by replacing vertices with basis vectors and edges with difference vectors ($e_u - e_v$). The requirement to connect a subset of vertices becomes a requirement to include specific target vectors in the linear span of the chosen subset. This forces models to bridge the gap between abstract vector spaces and graph components, defeating pattern matching on "equality constraints" or "graphs".
